item.title: 将RAG推理成本降低6倍，首先决定什么永远不进LLM
item.summary: Most teams building retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems for high stakes classification make the same architectural bet: Route every ambiguous case straight to the language model and trust the retrieved context to sort it out.
